newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks end down 1.61 pct on economic woes.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks end down 1.61 pct on economic woes.

text.p: Thai stocks, which moved in negative zone throughout the session on Tuesday, fell 1.61 percent in moderate trade after investors sold stocks on persistent worries about the Thai economy, brokers said.
The SET index, slipped for the fourth consecutive trading day, and fell 14.82 points to 905.81 on 4.07 billion baht turnover. The SET-50 index dropped 1.48 points to 68.55.
"Thailand's slow economic growth was the key factor forcing investors, including foreigners, to sell shares today," said Somchai Trairattanapirom of Sitca Investment and Securities.

All the major sectors on the board dipped today. The transportation sector fell most, declining 4.78 percent followed by the communication sector, which slipped 2.35 percent. The finance sector lost 1.98 percent and the banking sector fell 1.48 percent.
Krung Thai Bank topped the active list, falling two baht to 68. TelecomAsia gained 0.50 to 53.50 and Finance One lost two to 63.
Support is seen by some brokers at 900 points and resistance at 915 on Wednesday.
